The Blazor Web App is ready. Here's a summary:

**Architecture choices driven by your requirements:**

| Requirement | Solution |
|---|---|
| Fast first load, then snappy | **Auto render mode** — Server SSR on first visit, WebAssembly takes over |
| Worldwide users, latency-sensitive | WebAssembly runs client-side after download — no server round-trips |
| Every page interactive | Global `InteractiveAuto` on all pages |
| Individual accounts auth | ASP.NET Identity with SQLite, roles serialized to WASM client |

**What's built:**
- **`/dispatcher`** — Table of all shipments with filter, status dropdowns, and create form (Dispatcher role only)
- **`/my-shipments`** — Card-based view of customer's own shipments with delivery estimates
- **`/track`** — Public tracking page with progress bar (any authenticated user)
- **REST API** (`/api/shipments/*`) backing the interactive pages
- **Seed data** — 2 demo accounts and 5 sample shipments
